name: Ring Master I: The Shadow of Filias
summary: In the southern part of the continent Godlanta lies a small country known as Filias Nogis. Following an era of relative peace, the country must now face the greatest threat in its history: the powerful neighbor Tonade Ralei has invaded and occupied it. As the last of the Ring Knights, a once glorious guild of heroes, the protagonist must venture to Filias and save it.
